events.title: BASES Startup Career Fair
events.description: A curated group of startups hiring Stanford students for internships, new grad, full-time, and part-time roles. Meet founders, engineers, and recruiting teams, learn what they’re building, and explore where you could contribute.

notes: Visible date is 'Thursday November 5' with no year; 2026 confirmed by the Add to Google Calendar link (20261105T200000Z). The fair-week coffee chats and dinners are sub-sessions of this event and are not labeled separately.
